description: Kirschner has added 548 grassroots donors in seven weeks — 173 more than the Republican frontrunner gathered in nearly twice the time. The DCCC has named FL-16 one of 46 national 'Districts in Play' for 2026, the battlefield seats Democrats need to retake the House.
title: Kirschner Adds Grassroots Donors Nearly 3x Faster Than Gruters as National Democrats Put FL-16 on the Map to Retake the House - Kelly Kirschner for U.S. Congress - FL 16
